description:
Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound (FLCPS) intends to solicit for POLYCARBONATE SHEET

1 CLIN - 4 SHEETS - TUFFAK HYGARD BR1000 POLYCARBONATE SHEET, 4-PLY POLYCARBONATE 
LAMINATE, SIZE: 48” X 96” X 1” THK, COLOR: CLEAR.
*EQUIVALENT ACCEPTALBE ITEM*
LEXGARD MP1000 LAMINATE

SEE ATTACHED SOLICITATION FOR COMPLETE SPECIFICATIONS

All responsible sources may submit a quotation, bid, or proposal, as appropriate, which will be considered by the agency.

Quotes will be evaluated in accordance with RFO 12.203, the Government will select the most advantageous offer based on the following evaluation factors: technical including delivery date, price, and past performance in no order of relative importance.

Anticipated Award Date: 05/2026

Contracting Officer: Jeannine Cunningham
